close_reason: Won't fix as filed — the text blocks in tasks-types and calendars-types are intentional crate-family ASCII tree diagrams, not failed doctests. Adding actual rust example doctests is a separate concern, partially overlapping with JMAP-sc1b.22 (client crates with no lib.rs doctest).
